newsitem.title: USA: Total World Telecommunications Q1 shr loss.
newsitem.headline: Total World Telecommunications Q1 shr loss.

text.p: Total World Telecommunications Inc said Thursday it had a revenue increase in the first quarter of fiscal 1997 of almost seven fold to $10.7 million from the prior fiscal year's first quarter of $1.6 million, and the loss per share was $0.77.

The company attributed the revenue increase to the acquisition of Total National Telecommunications Inc and said the loss per share is attributable to certain operational start up costs for the two recent acquisitions of Southwestern Long Distance Inc and N'Touch, along with dividend payments to preferred stockholders.
